unit.why: A self-contained legend set in the time of Rav Sherira Gaon about Ezra the Scribe's Torah scroll, desecrated by an apostate and miraculously avenged; no Hasidic figures appear.

stories.start_quote: י) מעשה מה שהי׳ בספר תורה של עזרא הסופר
stories.summary_en: Two heirs of a rich man in Rav Sherira Gaon's day quarrel over a Torah scroll written by Ezra the Scribe and divide it by lot; a spiteful apostate falsifies a letter in it, and the winner falls ill with grief until his dead father reveals in a dream that the apostate's eye fell out under the table and that Ezra himself will repair the scroll, which comes true.

tags.why: Pre-Hasidic legend from the Geonic period glorifying the sanctity of Ezra's scroll

tags.why: Ezra the Scribe, a sofer, is the scroll's writer and its destined repairer
